Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub.: Intimation of Receipt of Purchase Order. 
Ref.: Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (“Listing Regulations”), we wish to inform that Innomet Advanced Materials Limited has received 
a Purchase Order dated February 12, 2026 from Hoganas India Pvt Ltd, an Indian Corporate, for the 
supply of Copper Powder. 
 
The total consideration of the said Purchase Order is Rs. 59.27 Lakhs (approximately), inclusive of 
applicable taxes and duties. 
 
The details as required under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 read with SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 
30, 2026, are enclosed herewith as ‘Annexure A’. 
 
Please acknowledge and take the same on your records. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
Thanking you, 
For Innomet Advanced Materials Limited
